claims.claim: Michigan State University researchers tested CaBP4 gene therapy in adult dogs with an inherited retinal condition.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Michigan State University College of Veterinary Medicine tested CaBP4 gene therapy in adult dogs with an inherited condition that disrupts calcium signaling.
claims.source_title: Researchers show adult retinas can repair themselves
claims.supporting_quote: The study, led by assistant professor and former resident Billie Beckwith-Cohen alongside endowed professor Simon Petersen-Jones challenges long-held assumptions about the ability of mature mammalian nerve cells to repair themselves.

claims.claim: A large health-record analysis linked glucosamine intake to a twenty-five percent higher chance of mild cognitive impairment advancing to dementia.
claims.episode_span: A large health-record analysis linked glucosamine intake to a twenty-five percent higher chance of mild cognitive impairment advancing to dementia.
claims.source_title: Glucosamine, a popular joint supplement, linked to faster Alzheimer’s progression
claims.supporting_quote: A large health-record analysis found that glucosamine use was associated with a 25% higher likelihood of mild cognitive impairment progressing to dementia.
